EXTRACTS FROM FRENCH POLICE INTELLIGENCE REPORT.
May 6, 1933.
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
S. B. REGISTRY
4844
2.15-33

The May 4 and May 5 Anniversaries.

The meeting planned to be held in the Chinese
Chamber of Commerce in commemoration of the student
movement in Peking was not held the Bureau of Public
Safety having refused to grant the necessary permission.
The meeting had been convoked by members of the various
public bodies in Shanghai.

These public bodies had also planned to hold
a meeting in the restaurant of the Y.M.C.A. at No. 123
Boulevard de Montigny, French Concession, at 2.30 p.m.
May 4, but the meeting was prohibited by the Political
Section of the French Police.

At 2.30 p.m. Chang Sui Yong, Director of Kwang
Hwa University and a dozen members of the Standing
Committee of the Federation of University Teachers
attempted to hold a meeting at the Y.M.C.A. but failed
because they couldnot find a suitable venue.

At 3 p.m. May 5 forty representatives of local
intellectual bodies held a meeting at the Young Men's
Lecturing Society, No. 1032 Chung Hwa Road, Nantao, to
celebrate the May 4 student movement. Ying Wan, the
representative of the local Tangpu, was present. Chang
Sui Yong presided. The following resolutions were passed:-

1) That the Central Government be requested to
fix May 4 as the date of the movement of the Chinese
renaissance.

2) That a League of Chinese Renaissance be
organized.

3) That the Federation of University Students
be entrusted with the preparatory work for the formation
of an educational club.

4) To prepare for the establishment of a
"Civilization Bank."

Kang Si Nie informed those present that the
meeting could not be held on May 4 because of Police
interference.

Meng Zeu Tseung made a report on the student
movement in Peking.

1933年5月6日。
上海公共租界工部局警务处
特别分部登记处
4844号
2.15-33

五四与五五纪念日。

原计划在上海总商会举行的、旨在纪念北京学生运动的集会未能举行，因公安局拒绝颁发必要许可。该集会由上海各公共团体的成员召集。

这些公共团体还计划于5月4日下午2时30分，在法租界蒙梯尼路（Boulevard de Montigny）123号青年会餐厅举行集会，但该集会被法国警察政治科禁止。

下午2时30分，光华大学校长张寿镛（Chang Sui Yong，音译）及大学教师联合会常务委员会的十余名成员试图在青年会举行集会，但因未能找到合适场地而未果。

5月5日下午3时，当地四十名知识界团体代表在南市中华路1032号青年宣讲社举行集会，庆祝五四学生运动。当地党部代表应万（Ying Wan，音译）出席。张寿镛主持。会议通过以下决议：

1) 请中央政府确定5月4日为中国文艺复兴运动之日。

2) 组织中国文艺复兴联盟。

3) 委托学生联合会负责筹备成立教育俱乐部。

4) 筹备建立“文明银行”。

康思聂（Kang Si Nie，音译）告知与会者，由于警方干涉，集会无法在5月4日举行。

孟泽将（Meng Zeu Tseung，音译）就北京学生运动作了报告。

Translation of a despatch No. Tseng ( 政 44 ) of
the Bureau of Public Safety addressed to the
Shanghai Municipal Police

----------

April 29, 1933.

The Commissioner,
Shanghai Municipal Police.

Sir,

In compliance with a secret order from
the Soong Wu Military Headquarters to the effect
that the military and the police should take
special precautions against unruly elements creating
disturbances on May 1, May 3, May 4, May 5, May 7,
May 9, May 18 and May 30, revolutionary anniversary
days, I have instructed my subordinates to comply.
You are hereby requested to instruct your men to
take special precautions on these anniversaries for
the sake of peace and good order.

Wen Hung-un (chopped)
Chief of the Bureau.

Original letter on file D.4801.

上海公共租界工部局警务处处长。

遵照淞沪警备司令部秘密命令，要求军警双方对5月1日、3日、4日、5日、7日、9日、18日及30日等革命纪念日期间不法分子制造骚乱的行为采取特别防范措施，本人已指令下属遵照执行。兹请贵处指令所属人员，为维持治安与秩序起见，在上述纪念日采取特别防范措施。

局长。

May 6, 1933. Morning Translation.

MISCELLANEOUS.

Central China Daily News and other local newspapers:

ANNIVERSARY OF INAUGURATION OF CHINESE REPUBLIC.

May 5 being the 12th anniversary of the
inauguration of the Republic of China, the local Tangpu
held a general commemoration meeting at 10 a.m. yesterday
in its auditorium at which about 310 representatives
including delegates of the Second High Court Branch, the
Land Bureau, the Public Works Bureau, the General Labour
Union, the General Post Office, the Fu Tan University
and various salvation association, etc. were present.
The following slogans were shouted at the
meeting:-
1. Do our best to abolish the unequal treaties
and to bring about the freedom and independence of our
country.
2. Exterminate the reactionary elements.
3. Bring about peace and unity.
4. Enforce a long-period Anti-Japanese movement
and recover the lost territories.

（批：D 4844）

1933年5月6日。晨间译文。

杂项。

《华中日报》及其他本地报纸：

中华民国成立周年纪念。

5月5日为中华民国成立十二周年纪念日，当地党部于昨日上午10时在其礼堂举行盛大纪念集会，出席者包括第二高等法院分院、土地局、工务局、总工会、邮政总局、复旦大学及各救国会等团体的代表，共约310人。
会上高呼以下口号：
1. 尽全力废除不平等条约，实现国家自由独立。
2. 肃清反动分子。
3. 实现和平统一。
4. 实行长期抗日运动，收复失地。

（批：D 4844）
